facts.fact: 她在正午阳光下确认自己的影子还在，影子短短地摊在鹅卵石上
facts.anchor: I checked to see if my shadow was still attached to my feet.

facts.fact: 宿醉里她反复回想 Rowan 说过的“装扮成不同公司”的话，以及老人讲的克隆与复制
facts.anchor: I couldn’t get what Rowan had said out of my mind. About the costumes.

facts.fact: 她自我说服：邻居没事，早上起来进城忙花去了，她没杀人
facts.anchor: But nothing had happened. My neighbour was fine.

facts.fact: 她想起手臂上那记“湿的骨裂”的触感，立刻反问自己若没发生为何记得这么清楚
facts.anchor: I felt the memory of a wet crunch of bone shuddering up my arms.

facts.fact: 她坐到河边的长椅上，一群女人在喂水鸟拍照，她盯着鸭妈妈领着一队小鸭
facts.anchor: A group of women had stopped at the waterside nearby, phones up, taking pictures.

facts.fact: 只剩她看见队伍渐渐甩开最小的一只小鸭，别人都没注意
facts.anchor: Only I was left watching the little duck family after they were gone.

facts.fact: 她想起母鸭嗅出孩子身上的弱与异样就会弃养，怕拖累或传染其他雏鸟
facts.anchor: When a mother senses something wrong, smells a weakness, an oddness, in her child, she’s driven to abandon it.

facts.fact: 鸭子钻进芦苇，小鸭独自直直游走、叫着消失；她得出结论：必须装得更好，否则会被闻出来、被丢下
facts.anchor: See, this is why you have to pretend.
